env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Compile-time constants agree with ordinary function execution and eject.
cd m
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/ctfe_assignment_order.lgo main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/ctfe_assignment_order.out expected.txt
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
exists $UPROOT1274/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ctfeassignment

go 1.27
